Title: Document G
Content: When a girl leaves her home at `text(eighteen)`, she does `text(one)` of `text(two)` things. Either she falls into saving hands and becomes better, or she rapidly assumes that cosmopolitan standard of virtue and becomes worse. Of an intermediate balance, under the circumstances, there is no possibility. The city has its cunning wiles ... A blare of sound, a roar of life, a vast array of human hives, appeal to the astonished sense in equivocal terms ... Unrecognized for what they are, their beauty, like music, too often relaxes, then weakens ,then perverts the simpler human perceptions.
